summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload in a Vue component package
details: @onereach/si-radio-group is advertised as a Vue radio-group input component but its package.json preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime binary (pinned to v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, chmods it 0755, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])` to run the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated file tagged `// @bun @bun-cjs`, containing hex-mangled identifiers, a large opaque numeric/string constant table, and a string-array rotation routine (`WV8StW` performing `push(shift())`). Neither the Bun runtime nor a math module has any bearing on a Vue input component. The alternate-runtime delivery mechanism executes package-controlled, non-human-readable code on the installer's host at `npm install` time, bypassing Node-based scanners that would otherwise trace the payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
